subject: Error in is.nan(scores) : default method not implemented for type 'list'

messages.author: dff35b5719cbb7c3
messages.subject: Error in is.nan(scores) : default method not implemented for type 'list'
parts:
Hello Phil.

I am on mirt version 1.32.1 (cran) and am getting the error

Error in is.nan(scores) : default method not implemented for type 'list'

when attempting to run fscores with a response.pattern. The model is a previously calibrated model on a different dataset and I am scoring a new response pattern. I have tried a few different things like changing the method, providing priors, etc. I have also tried changing the matrix for the response.pattern to different formats with no success.

However, if I take random slices of the data it does sometimes work. For example if I just try and score head() I get the fscores. I guess there is something in these data triggering the error but I don't understand what is causing it or how to avoid it.

Here are some data and code to reproduce.

Data: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LMSCskvKUuGCuyn_OHhadnG0qdLY8CCc/view?usp=sharing

Model: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ObNAGN1eN36eHLOXf7ABwN_ARMqr5gHv/view?usp=sharing

Code:
readRDS(file = "/conf_threepl_2_model_free_v1.RDS") -> model

read.csv(file = "/data_example.csv) -> score_matrix

fscores(model,
        response.pattern = score_matrix,
        full.scores = TRUE) -> irt_scores

messages.author: dff35b5719cbb7c3
messages.subject: Re: Error in is.nan(scores) : default method not implemented for type 'list'
parts: Nevermind I figured it out! There were a few rows with too few responses causing the error. I guess the error was due to an infinite theta value.
